about: A self-hosted ebook library server with a built-in reader, KOReader sync and an OPDS feed.

prs.title: Downloaded EPUBs stay valid when the book has an ISBN
prs.broken: Downloading a book with an ISBN set gave a broken EPUB: writing the ISBN removed the identifier that marks the book, and readers like calibre flagged the file.
prs.changed: Only other ISBN entries are replaced now. The book's own identifier is left exactly as it was.
prs.matters: Downloaded books open everywhere, and their embedded fonts keep working.

prs.title: ISBNs are read from calibre and retail EPUBs
prs.broken: Imported EPUBs from calibre or shops never got an ISBN, because only the first identifier was checked and that is usually a different id.
prs.changed: The import now looks for an identifier marked as an ISBN first, then a plain number with no other label.
prs.matters: Books get their ISBN on import, so metadata lookups find them.
